name: Halloweekends 万圣节游乐园
address: Calaway Park（卡城以西，具体地址请查官网）

descEn: Calaway Park transforms into a Halloween wonderland with parades and character meet-and-greets. Address and phone not verified — check the website before going.

name: Ghouls' Night Out 万圣节之夜
desc: 历史村庄变身万圣节乐园，有迷宫和饼干装饰，分级惊吓适合各年龄。往年参考价成人$24.95/儿童$18.95，官网电话未核实。
descEn: The historic village becomes a Halloween playground with mazes and cookie decorating; graded scares suit every age. Past reference price: adult $24.95 / child $18.95; phone not verified.
scheduleEn: Weekend evenings in late October each year

name: Once Upon a Christmas 圣诞村

descEn: Wagon rides, visits with Santa and a Christmas market — the most old-fashioned Christmas atmosphere for families. Separate tickets required; phone not verified.

name: Calgary Stampede 牛仔节
address: Stampede Park（市中心，具体地址请查官网）
desc: “地球上最伟大的户外秀”：游乐设施、农场动物、原住民表演，7月必去。门票制，有家庭套票，部分时段免费入场。地址官网未核实。
descEn: “The Greatest Outdoor Show on Earth”: midway rides, farm animals and Indigenous performances — a must every July. Ticketed, with family packs and some free-admission windows; address not verified.

name: Pumpkins After Dark 南瓜灯展

descEn: Over 6,000 hand-carved jack-o'-lanterns along a walking trail — Canada's largest Halloween light display, made for photos. Tickets required; address not verified.

name: Chinook Blast 冬季节
address: 市中心多处场地（具体请查官网）
desc: 融合灯光艺术与冬季运动的冬日庆典，多数活动免费。具体场地官网未核实，去前查官网。
descEn: Winter festival blending light art with winter sports; most events are free. Venues not verified — check the website before going.

name: Prairie Winds Park 喷水公园
desc: 东北最大的免费戏水去处：喷水池加涉水池，还有游乐场、滑草坡和野餐区。免费。
schedule: 喷水公园夏季开放（约6月底-9月初）；公园全年 5:00-23:00
descEn: The NE's biggest free splash spot: spray park plus wading pool, with playgrounds, grassy hills and picnic areas. Free.
scheduleEn: Spray park open summer (approx. late June–early Sept); park open year-round 5:00–23:00

name: Rotary Park 喷水公园

descEn: Small neighbourhood spray park in the NE — quiet and uncrowded, perfect for a quick outing with little ones. Free, open in summer.

name: Bowness Park 涉水池
desc: 大型涉水池加周边喷水区，夏天划船冬天滑冰，还有儿童小火车，卡城家庭公园天花板。免费。
schedule: 涉水池约6月中-秋季每天 9:00-21:00；冬季泻湖免费滑冰
descEn: Big wading pool plus spray areas, boating in summer and skating in winter, plus a children's mini-train — Calgary's ultimate family park. Free.
scheduleEn: Wading pool approx. mid-June–fall, daily 9:00–21:00; free lagoon skating in winter

name: Riley Park 涉水池
desc: 老牌社区公园，涉水池加大游乐场，旁边就是Kensington冰淇淋街。免费，夏季开放。
descEn: Classic community park with a wading pool and big playground, next to Kensington's ice-cream strip. Free, open in summer.

name: Valleyview Park 喷水公园
address: 28 St与30 Ave SE附近（具体门牌未核实）
desc: 无障碍设计的彩色喷水公园，四个喷水结构，东南区夏日热门。具体地址未核实，去前查官网。免费。
descEn: Barrier-free colourful spray park with four spray structures — a SE summer favourite. Address not verified; check the website. Free.

name: Pearce Estate Park 湿地公园
desc: 湿地主题公园，有特色游乐场和木栈道，观鸟散步两相宜。具体地址未核实。免费，全年开放。
descEn: Wetland-themed park with a unique playground and boardwalks — great for birdwatching and strolls. Address not verified. Free, open year-round.

address: 市中心（具体地址未核实）

descEn: Downtown oasis-style splash plaza where kids can cool off between shopping trips. Exact address unverified. Free, open in summer.

scheduleEn: By appointment; schedules vary by location

descEn: Kids' karate, Muay Thai, and kickboxing classes; free trial bookable on the website. Address and phone unverified — check the website before visiting.

scheduleEn: By appointment; regular classes on weekends and weekday evenings

name: KidsCanSwim 免费游泳试课

descEn: Kids' swim school offering free assessment trials before placement — ideal for beginners. Location and phone unverified; book online.

name: City of Calgary "Try It!" 体验课
desc: 市府推出的低价体验课程，涵盖健身、瑜伽、武术等，低价尝试再决定是否长期学。按季度排课。
descEn: City-run low-cost trial classes in fitness, yoga, martial arts and more — try before committing to a full term. Scheduled quarterly.

name: Calgary Farmers' Market West

scheduleEn: Weekend performances during the season; each show runs for several weeks
